text.config.interactic.title: Interactic Configuration
text.config.interactic.option.clientOnly: Disable every feature that requires Interactic on the server.
text.config.interactic.option.rightClick: Allow players to pick up dropped items by clicking them or using the pickup key.
text.config.interactic.option.filterSnea: Allow sneaking players to bypass their item filter.
text.config.interactic.option.autoPickup: Allow dropped items to be picked up through normal collision.
text.config.interactic.option.fancyItemR: Replace vanilla dropped-item rendering with Interactic's animated layout.
text.config.interactic.option.renderItem: Show the name of the dropped item under the crosshair.
text.config.interactic.option.renderFull: Show the dropped item's complete tooltip.
text.config.interactic.option.itemThrowi: Charge the drop key to throw items farther.
text.config.interactic.option.itemsActAs: Allow thrown weapons and tools to damage entities.
text.config.interactic.option.swingArm.d: Swing the player's arm when an item is dropped or thrown.
text.config.interactic.option.blocksLayF: Lay block items flat instead of giving them a random three-dimensional rotation.
